picker.historyEmptyDescription: Whatever you upload stays here, and you can use it again on any table without uploading it twice.
picker.publishedEmptyDescription: Admins publish templates and documents here for every table to use.
picker.noResultsDescription: None of your files match the search.

table.title: Table files
table.attachTitle: Add a file to the table
table.attachDescription: Upload a new one or reuse something you already have. The file is linked, not copied: removing it here does not delete it.
table.privateLabel: Only for whoever runs the table
table.privateHint: Left unchecked, players and candidates see it too.
table.emptyDescription: Preparation material, maps and anything you want to share with your players goes here.
table.detachTitle: Remove the file from this table?
table.detachDescription: It stops showing on this table. The file still exists, in your own list and on any other table using it.
table.readOnlyEmptyDescription: Nothing has been shared on this table yet.
table.someFailed: Could not upload: {{names}}. The rest were added.

admin.title: Files
admin.description: The community's library: what is published for every table and what waits to be published.
admin.emptyDescription: Once you upload the community's blank sheet or its rules, they will show up here.
admin.deleteDescription: It stops showing on every table using it. It is not erased from disk: that is the owner's, from their maintenance menu.
admin.unpublishDescription: It stops being offered to masters, but it stays in the library and you can publish it again. Tables that already added it keep it.
admin.publishDescription: Masters will see it right away and can add it to their tables. If you hide it later, tables that already added it keep it.

category.filterLabel: Filter by where it is used

dropzone.prompt: Drag a file here, or click to pick one
dropzone.promptMultiple: Drag the files here, or click to pick them
dropzone.limits: Up to {{maxMb}} MB per file. PDF, Word, PNG and JPG are accepted.
dropzone.reused: You already had “{{name}}”: it was reused and takes no extra space.
dropzone.categoryHint: Only needed here: when you upload from a table or an answer, the drawer follows from where you uploaded it.

errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: That file type is not accepted. You can upload PDF, Word, PNG and JPG.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than allowed. The maximum is 2 MB per file.
errors.FILE_EMPTY: The file is empty. Pick another one.

mine.title: My files
mine.description: Everything you have uploaded. When you attach something to a table you can reuse one of these: it is not duplicated and takes no extra space.
mine.emptyTitle: You have not uploaded anything yet
mine.emptyDescription: Whatever you upload stays here and can be used again on any table, without uploading it twice.
mine.noResultsDescription: None of your files match the search.
mine.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” stops appearing in your list and on the tables that use it. It is not erased from disk: the owner does that from the maintenance menu.
mine.someFailed: Could not upload: {{names}}. The rest are in. Try again with those.
mine.reused: You already had “{{names}}”: it was reused and takes no extra space.
mine.noLibraryTitle: Your account has no library of its own
mine.noLibraryDescription: Personal files are uploaded from the player and master flows: an application, a submission, a table’s material. The files the platform publishes for the community are in Administration → Files.

edit.title: Edit file
edit.description: Change what it is called, what it is, and whether you are keeping it. The content is untouched.
edit.keepHint: Unchecked, it stays tied to where you used it and is released after a long time unused.

upload.title: Upload files
upload.description: Choose what each file is, then whether you publish it now or leave it in the library to publish later.
upload.missingCategory_one: 1 file still needs to say what it is.
upload.missingCategory_other: {{count}} files still need to say what they are.
upload.reused: You had already uploaded {{names}}: that same copy was published.
upload.someFailed: Could not upload: {{names}}. The rest are in.
upload.confirmDraftDescription_one: It stays in the library and no master sees it until you publish it.
upload.confirmDraftDescription_other: They stay in the library and no master sees them until you publish them.
upload.confirmPublishDescription_one: Masters will see it right away and can add it to their tables. If you hide it later, tables that already added it keep it.
upload.confirmPublishDescription_other: Masters will see them right away and can add them to their tables. If you hide one later, tables that already added it keep it.

libraryEdit.title: Change what it is
libraryEdit.description: “{{name}}” is not published: you can change its drawer before publishing it.
